slot_purpose: WordPress + Divi, server-rendered, no sitemap, lazy-loaded images, index spam
why_this_slot_matters: No sitemap anywhere, which is what blocks V2 entirely (D-1).
Divi wraps body copy in divs outside the element selector set (D-5).
Every is a W3 Total Cache lazyload data-URI placeholder; the real URL is in data-src (D-18).
Hero and section backgrounds are CSS background-image, recoverable from no HTML-level extractor.
Internal links are relative and target index.html, with no canonical tag sitewide.
Three injected SEO-spam URLs remain in the search index.
A broken internal target (/meet-the-team, 403) is linked five times from the homepage.
The team page nests h3 roles under h2 names, which the V2 segmenter splits wrongly (D-9).
Every on all eight pages is a lazyload data: placeholder, so the whole site exercises D-18, not just one page.

fixtures.comment: Raw HTML is deliberately NOT committed. It is a third party's copyrighted content collected to rebuild their own site. The corpus holds assertions; the bytes stay outside the repository and are matched by sha256.

additional_raw_html_available.note: The other .html files there are ~290-byte 301 stubs and are worthless.

fixtures.capture_format: pages/<slug>.json carries {url, markdown, links, images, metadata, provenance} as emitted by capture.py; raw-html/<slug>.html is the authoritative fetched bytes and is what every raw_html_sha256 is taken from.
fixtures.note: The 2026-10-10 capture covered 2 of 8 pages and its markdown was hand transcribed. The 2026-10-12 capture covers all 8 with no transcription step. The slot directory keeps its original date because that is when the slot was established.

coverage.note: All eight content URLs captured 2026-10-12. G-2 and G-3 now score the whole site.

client_findings.comment: Facts about the source site that the capture surfaced. They are not gate inputs; they are what a migration has to tell the client. Recorded here so a later run can check they were reported rather than silently carried across.

items.detail: /contact/thank-you shows 8193 Avery Rd #100, Broadview Heights OH 44147 while every other page and the sitewide footer show 7500 Town Centre Dr Suite 100. Both strings appear on that one page. A patient who books an appointment lands on it and is given the wrong address. Capture it verbatim, flag it, and let the client decide which is correct - never reconcile it silently.
/meet-the-team returns 403 and is linked five times from the homepage, including the hero call to action and the 'Meet Dr. Olteanu' card. The real page is /dental-team.
The fax number is written as href="440.746.9070", so /440.746.9070 404s.
Injected .shtml URLs with Japanese product titles remain in Google's index from an old compromise. The set drifts between crawls; three to four are visible at a time.
dental-hygienist-nicole.jpg carries alt 'Nicole Jeglie is a registered dental hygienist' under a heading reading 'Nicole Langford'.
article:modified_time per page: faq 2018-09-28, dental-team 2019-04-29, home 2023-08-01. Most of the site has not been touched in six or seven years.
/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/New-patient-packet.pdf is linked client content and must be transferred; an asset-extension filter would discard it as noise.
